card.name: Inside capitalized CLINICAL cross-references
card.fires_on: The letters IN inside the all-caps word CLINICAL (CL-IN-ICAL) in cross-references like "see CLINICAL PHARMACOLOGY" or "CLINICAL STUDIES". Rarely, it fires on a word like HAVE in all-caps warnings.

modes.label: CL-IN-ICAL split
modes.description: The IN piece in capitalized CLINICAL inside a bracketed or parenthetical section reference.
modes.example: Both dosages demonstrated effectiveness in clinical trials [see CL<<IN>>ICAL STUDIES (14) ].

modes.label: All-caps warning verb
modes.description: A weaker case on HAVE in an all-caps boxed warning sentence.
modes.example: IN SPITE OF THE USE OF AN INFUSION PUMP, OVERDOSES<< HAVE>> OCCURRED.

card.plain: It marks the middle of the capitalized word CLINICAL when a label points the reader to the Clinical Pharmacology or Clinical Studies section.
